publication_cadence.live_news: Require actual new upstream identities within the window and record their supported source times; HTTP 200 or changed fetch time alone is insufficient.
publication_cadence.daily_edition: Apply the continuous window and independently verify two real editorial dates. Record whether a new edition was actually observed; archive reads do not count as newly published editions.
publication_cadence.slow_longform_reviews: Do not require daily publication. Compare the current list with the origin and record actual latest item dates and lack of observed updates. A stale mirror is not current discovery.
publication_cadence.previews_questions_media: Judge only the declared public preview/background/description. No answer consensus, subscription fulltext, transcript, viewing conclusion, duration, or timecode claim without corresponding material.

records_required: exact source ID, route, image/revision, config fingerprint and observation timestamps
every scheduled success and failure; no dropped failed rounds or recycled R0 observations
source identities, titles, author role/basis, distinct time meanings and precision
material URL, HTTP/access result, scope, completeness basis, response/text fingerprints
cache-span evidence, real new identities, verified source dates, and quiet/stale distinction
explicit pass/observe/blocked per path, measured window only, no long-term stability claim
notes: Six hours, thirteen half-hour samples and two local dates are an R1 bounded integration gate, not proof of seven-day or long-term source stability.
The window crosses the deployed 30-minute feed and 60-minute body cache settings; retain unchanged fingerprints when upstream is quiet rather than forcing cache-bypass requests.
Only independently passing paths may be enabled. Failed paths remain off with evidence and do not authorize lower quality gates or higher budget.
These rules are frozen before the target observation window. Later revisions require a new version and reason, retaining the first results.
